headline: Celtics fall flat in Philly and now it all comes down to a massive Game 7
morning_brew: The Celtics absolutely choked away a chance to end it in Philly. Tyrese Maxey went off for thirty points and the C's had no answer. Jayson Tatum finished with seventeen points and Jaylen Brown had eighteen, but the energy just was not there. It is a total disastah to let a team that you beat by thirty-two twice in this series hang around like this. Now we are heading back to the Garden for a Game 7 where everything is on the line. Eighteenth banners do not win themselves, and this group needs to wake up before the season ends in a heartbreak.

Things are not looking much better for the Sox as they head back to Fenway Park to host the Astros. We are sitting at 12-19 and carrying a three-game home losing streak into this set. The bats have been quiet and the vibe around the Fens is pretty salty right now. Ownership is watching a sub-.400 team while the fans are wondering when the turnaround actually starts. We need a win tonight to stop the bleeding, because the AL East waits for nobody. It is time for someone in that dugout to step up and lead.

Bruins fans are ready to erupt tonight at the Garden as the playoff series against Buffalo continues. After forty-five wins in the regular season, the expectations are sky-high for this group to make a deep run. Meanwhile, the Patriots have a deadline today on those fifth-year options for the 2023 draft class. It is a big day for the front office to decide who is part of the long-term plan in Foxborough after a fourteen-win season last year. Between the ice and the front office, there is plenty of drama to keep every townie in the Hub busy.
